milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining pink stained glass with the Silk Touch pickaxe (provided in scene) drops the block as an item into inventory. Without Silk Touch, glass drops nothing, but the scene gives a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe. Pink stained glass blocks are at the north gallery wall (~-2 to ~2, ~1, ~-10).

Uses inventory_has because crafting yellow stained glass (8 glass + 1 yellow dye in 3x3 crafting grid) places the result in the player's inventory. Materials are available in a chest at ~-2,~1,~-8 in the glass gallery, and a crafting table is at ~1,~0,~-7.

Uses inventory_has because mining a hay block with Silk Touch yields the hay_block item in inventory. Hay blocks are placed at ~8-9,~1-2,~0-1 in the farm area. With Silk Touch the block itself drops rather than 9 wheat.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sugar (1 sugar cane → 1 sugar, shapeless recipe usable in 2x2 player grid) places sugar in inventory. Sugar cane is harvestable at ~10,~1,~-1 in the farm area adjacent to the hay blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate to the bedroom wing entrance and look at the potted white tulip. Target is at ~-7,~1,~0. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually enters the wing (target is ~7 blocks from spawn, so player must walk closer). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate into the bedroom wing and look at the purple bed. Target is at ~-10,~0,~1 (bed foot position). max_distance=8 requires the player to be inside or at the entrance of the bedroom wing. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the bed.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate into the bedroom wing and look at the blue stained glass pane window on the far west wall. Target is at ~-12,~2,~0 (center of the 3-pane window). max_distance=8 requires the player to be well inside the bedroom wing. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player faces the window.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished blackstone with a pickaxe drops polished blackstone as an item. The Nether wing walls at ~-4 and ~4, ~1-3, ~6-12 are made of polished blackstone, providing abundant blocks to mine.

Uses inventory_has because mining red nether brick slab with a pickaxe drops the slab item. Red nether brick slabs are placed as a decorative shelf at ~-2 to ~2, ~1, ~8 inside the Nether wing (5 slabs available).

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron door (6 iron ingots in a 2x3 pattern on crafting table) places iron doors in inventory. The chest at ~0,~0,~11 in the Nether wing contains 12 iron ingots, more than sufficient for the 6 required.

Uses inventory_has because obtaining a salmon bucket (by using an empty bucket on a salmon entity in water) places salmon_bucket in the player's inventory. Despite the task name 'craft to', this is actually a use-item-on-entity action. The bucket is in the Nether wing chest at ~0,~0,~11 and salmon are contained in the glass-pane-enclosed pond at ~7-9,~0,~7-9.
